about: The project's configuration of the delivery flow (D23). `/flow-init` fills it; scripts read it through `.claude/scripts/flow-config.mjs`, and the procedures name its values as `commands.check` and so on. An empty string means the project has none of that thing.

commands.about: Shell commands run from the repository root. `taskTest` and `taskDown` contain `{task}`: the test suite on the task's own resources (its own database, its own ports) and their removal, so tasks developed side by side never share state. `taskTest` empty means `test`.

delivery.about: `versioning`: VERSION and CHANGELOG.md are bumped and the merge commit tagged. `draftPullRequests`: the repository supports draft pull requests (public, or private on GitHub Team/Enterprise); without them a PR not yet ready carries a `Draft: ` title prefix. `deploy`: the main workflow deploys and its smoke job checks the site. `rollback`: a command the Coordinator may run once to restore the last verified deployment; empty means recovery is a revert pull request.

outsideReview.about: Outside review by OpenAI's Codex CLI under the owner's account (D12): off unless enabled, and then only for branches touching one of these areas of `.claude/delivery-areas.json`.

design.about: `figma`: new screens get two or three Figma directions the owner picks from before implementation.

schedule.about: Cron expressions of the two scheduled tasks `/flow-init` creates, and the grooming fire that sends the owner the morning notification.
